structure.unit: Boundary Adjustments and Changes of Status of Counties, Cities and Towns
Consolidation of Like Units of Local Government

law.catch_line: Magisterial, school and election districts, etc
law.text: The magisterial districts in a county, and the school districts, election districts and voting places in the consolidated county, city or town shall continue as in the several counties, cities or towns prior to consolidation, unless and until changed in accordance with law.
